item.group_name: Short video from a picture or text
item.title: Quiet Lake Website Loop

turns.text: Make a 6-second seamless loop for my website background: a calm mountain lake at dusk, with gentle ripples. Wide 16:9, camera staying still, no text or sound. Keep it subtle so I can put my own heading over it.

item.tests: Tests whether the delivered website background has subtle real motion and a visually seamless repeat rather than merely being a short scenic video.

answer_sheet.Source image: Generate the scene; I’m not providing a photo.
answer_sheet.Visual style and mood: Realistic, peaceful mountain lake at dusk, with subdued colours.
answer_sheet.Motion and looping: Gentle water ripples, a fixed camera, and no visible jump when it repeats.
answer_sheet.Size and placement: Wide 16:9 website background; keep the centre calm enough for my own heading.

must_haves: The deliverable is a 6-second landscape 16:9 video showing a mountain lake at dusk.
Gentle ripples visibly animate the water; the output is not a static image held for six seconds.
The camera remains fixed, with no pans, zooms or scene cuts.
Repeated playback has no perceptible jump, flash or abrupt motion reset at the boundary.
The centre remains visually calm, without prominent moving foreground objects competing with a website heading.
There is no visible text and no audible sound.

dialog.agent:
**I haven’t started a generation or spent any generation credits.** I can’t verify an exact credit quote or your balance with the tools available here, so I won’t run it without a confirmed cost and your approval.

For your request, the free-plan option would be **480p, 16:9, silent**, using a free-eligible video model. One limitation: prompting for a seamless loop doesn’t guarantee a clean join; a short crossfade in editing may be needed.

### Cheaper options
- **Shorter video:** A 3–4-second loop at 480p is worth pricing against 6 seconds, though I can’t confirm the savings here.
- **Still background:** A single 640px landscape image starts at **5 credits** with a free-eligible image model. It has no real ripples but is much lighter for a website.
- **No generation:** Use an existing lake photo as a static background—zero Magic Hour generation credits.

For the video, I’d use this direction:
> Locked-off wide shot of a calm mountain lake at dusk, muted blue and lavender tones, gentle low-amplitude ripples, stable lighting and reflections. Minimal motion, low contrast, uncluttered central area for a heading. No camera movement, people, text, or audio. Match the beginning and ending as closely as possible for looping.

**Also check usage rights:** Magic Hour’s guide says commercial use requires a paid subscription, credit-pack purchase, or agreed paid usage arrangement. A free account alone may not cover a business website.

If you share the credit estimate shown in Magic Hour for **6 seconds versus 3–4 seconds at 480p**, I can help compare them before anything runs.

Do you mean the **original 6-second video**, a **3–4-second loop**, or the **5-credit still image**?

I still can’t verify the video’s exact cost here, so I haven’t started anything. Your earlier “confirm the cost first” limit remains in place.
dialog.user: The cheaper 3–4-second loop at 480p—ok, go ahead with that, but confirm the credit cost before running it.
